Definition: Whether the country has an operational Internet Exchange Point (IXP) and its maturity. IXPs enable local internet traffic to be exchanged domestically rather than being routed internationally, reducing latency, costs, and dependence on foreign infrastructure. Critical for local digital ecosystem development.
Comments: No IXP found in PeeringDB/PCH; score 1 No IXP
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Confirmed: a 2025 infrastructure review (citing Internet Society Pulse/A4AI data) explicitly states there is no local IXP in Sao Tome and Principe, with all traffic routed via the single ACE submarine cable; BGP data (bgp.he.net) shows the country's two ASNs peering only with international transit providers (AFR-IX, GVA Cote d'Ivoire), consistent with no domestic exchange. Original claim was unsupported (no source cited) but is corroborated by these sources. Value Code 1 (No IXP) confirmed, unchanged.

Definition: The availability and presence of major cloud service providers (hyperscale and regional) operating in or serving the country with local or near-local infrastructure. Cloud availability determines access to scalable computing resources for government, business, and startups.
Value Name: Served remotely from distant regions only (>100ms latency)
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Confirmed directionally: AWS's only African region is Cape Town (af-south-1, launched 2020), with Azure/GCP likewise concentrated in South Africa/Nigeria/Kenya — none in or near Sao Tome and Principe. No commercial data centre or cloud region serves the country locally; it depends on the single ACE submarine cable for international connectivity (ts2.tech, 2025), consistent with 'served remotely from distant regions only'. Note: two AI-generated market-report sites (stateglobe.com, 6wresearch.com) surfaced during search with fabricated-looking country-specific cloud statistics (e.g. invented AWS market-share percentages for a 240k-population state) and were disregarded as unreliable. Value Code 2 confirmed, unchanged, though precise latency (>100ms) could not be independently verified — recommend human review if exact threshold matters.

revision_notes: Confirmed: Tracxn (accessed 2026) records only ~57 companies in the country, of which 5-6 are funded, with cumulative disclosed VC/PE funding of just US$196K and the most recent tracked round dating to 2014 — no meaningful current VC activity. AfriLabs lists a single affiliated hub (Startup Sao Tome / SOW Hub), no Disrupt Africa or Partech coverage of the country was found. This matches 'Nascent' with very few startups and no visible VC activity. Value Code 1 confirmed, unchanged.
